text:
sofia.pm: Heads-up: planning a schema cutover for analytics.events to add 'event_namespace' partitioning. Target window next Tuesday 11:00-13:00 UTC. No expected downtime but there's a dual-write window + backfill.

alex.chang: Can you confirm who will run the DB steps vs the backfill job? I can own the backfill if ops agrees on sizing.

mira.khan: I can run the migration and the cutover commands (DB access). alex, if you take the backfill we should coordinate the throttling.

chris_db: Throttling note: the backfill will spawn ~20 workers by default. Recommend starting with 5 and increase in 30m increments. Watch replication lag.

sofia.pm: Plan: 11:00 cutoff to enable dual-write (app writes to old and new schema), 11:15 run quick smoke, 11:30 start backfill at low concurrency, 12:45 finish backfill and validate, 12:55 cut traffic to new schema, 13:00 monitor. Rollback window until 14:00 if issues.

jenna_swe: I'll schedule the canary deploy at 11:05 to point 5% of traffic to the new schema path. Ops-bot can we add the canary route? @ops-bot

ops-bot: @jenna_swe Canary route created: analytics-events-canary -> 5% traffic. Deployed to staging + canary route ready.

alex.chang: Backfill job outline (will run in k8s batch): image: registry/redwood/backfill:v2, job args: --table analytics.events --batch-size 1000 --partition event_namespace. Will start with --concurrency 5.

mira.khan: Smoke checks (run at 11:15) — quick SQLs to validate writes and reads:
```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM analytics.events_new WHERE created_at > now() - interval '5 minutes';
SELECT count(*) FROM analytics.events_old WHERE created_at > now() - interval '5 minutes';
-- verify sample event namespace present
SELECT event_namespace, count(*) FROM analytics.events_new GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 5;
```

chris_db: Monitoring to watch: replication lag, 95th p99 write latency, RDS CPU, and the backfill job failure rate. I will attach a dashboard and add alerts for replication_lag > 5s.

sofia.pm: Rollback plan if read errors or regressions: 1) disable canary route (ops) 2) re-enable reads from old schema (app feature flag) 3) stop backfill job (alex) 4) run quick integrity checks. Everyone ok with that order?

alex.chang: Sounds good. If we need to rollback fully, backfill is idempotent but partial writes may exist — we'll run a reconciliation job next day.

jenna_swe: Quick deploy checklist for me:
- feature flag: analytics_new_schema = on (canary)
- routing: canary 5% -> ops-bot done
- health endpoint: /health/schema -> returns v2
- smoke script run by mira

ops-bot: Added alert: migration-backfill-job > 10% failures in 10m -> paging to eng-oncall.

mira.khan: One more thing: dual-write window length. We plan for 2h by default but will extend if backfill needs more time. Any objections?

chris_db: No objections. If backfill blocks longer than 3h, we throttle writes at application level to reduce backlog.

sofia.pm: Final: owner assignments: migration & DB steps = mira.khan, backfill = alex.chang, canary & routing = jenna_swe + ops-bot, monitoring/alerts = chris_db, PM coord = sofia.pm. I'll post the runbook and update calendar invite.

alex.chang: I'll post the k8s job manifest after lunch.

mira.khan: I'll be at my laptop during the window. Ping me in this thread when you start the canary.

sofia.pm: Great — tagging deploy checklist: @jenna_swe @alex.chang @mira.khan @chris_db. Let's keep next messages focused on blockers.

jenna_swe: LGTM :thumbsup:

chris_db: One small blocker: need an extra DB connection slot for the backfill in the pool config. Can someone bump the pool by +10 for the window?@infra-team

sofia.pm: @infra-team can you increase DB pool max_connections for the migration window?

ops-bot: infra-team notified: increase DB pool until 2026-03-24T14:00:00Z.

mira.khan: Noted. I'll add a post-check at 13:05 to validate indexes and run a quick sample query for latency.

alex.chang: Posting the partial k8s job manifest here for visibility:
```yaml
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: analytics-backfill-2026-03-24
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: backfill
        image: registry/redwood/backfill:v2
        args: ["--table", "analytics.events", "--partition", "event_namespace", "--batch-size", "1000", "--concurrency", "5"]
      restartPolicy: Never
```

sofia.pm: Perfect. I'll update the invite with the final checklist and link this thread. Thanks everyone — we reconvene here during the window for live notes.
